summary: Confirmed a real rendered recovery-action gap in the public directory: a retryable school-cascade failure leaves directory matches loaded, shows the lookup error, and retains controller retry capability, but renderPublicSite emits no public:retry button. An explicit controller dispatch recovers the counties fixture. No repository source was changed.
source_refs: checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-site.mjs:38-54 gates rendered directory retry only on matches.status === 'error'; status text also renders j.error.
checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.mjs:242-269 marks the school lookup retryable and retains schoolLookupRetry.
checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.test.mjs:1069-1078 proves controller retry from directory but does not inspect the rendered tree.
minimal_proposed_correction: In the directory renderer, when matches.status is not 'error' and lookupError is present with lookupRetryable true, render a distinct 'Retry school choices' public:retry button. Keep the existing retry-search branch for directory failures so the visible control matches the operation currently owned by the controller retry dispatcher.
secondary_observation: After successful retry, lookupError clears but journey.error remains the prior failure text; directory renders result.error || journey.error, so the old failure message remains visible. Consider clearing journey.error on successful lookup when it still equals the recovered lookup error.
